parts.name: garment
parts.keep: the whole rotted linen dress with its wide torn sleeves, from the neckline down to its torn hem at the ankles, the twisted rope belt at the waist, without the fur shawl, as a garment on its own: no body, no head, no arms, no hands, no legs, the garment hollow inside where the body was, seen straight from the front
